This bill covers the entire project: the main underground shelter, the entry
headhouse and covered stairwell, the escape shafts, the engineered cover, the
sentry post with its **brick masonry walls**, the services, the external works and
the concealment works.

**Nothing here is fabricated.** Every quantity is either taken directly from an
existing project package, or derived from confirmed project geometry with the
arithmetic shown. The full derivation, including the source of every input, is in
`Schedules/BOQ_QUANTITY_DERIVATION.txt` — 800 lines of working that can be checked
line by line.

Where a quantity genuinely cannot be determined from the project record, the item
says **To be verified from final measurement** and the reason is stated. It is not
estimated and it is not omitted.

### Basis of measurement

* Measurement follows the IS 1200 series (Part 1 earthwork, Part 2 concrete,
  Part 3 brickwork, Part 5 formwork, Part 12 plastering). To be verified against the applicable MES SOR/SSR/specification edition.
* Concrete volumes for the shelter and entry structures are taken **verbatim** from
  `Structural CAD/Schedules/REINFORCEMENT_SUMMARY.md` (package SC1). Six of the
  eight lines were independently re-derived here and reproduce exactly; the main
  staircase and entry stairwell are composite figures accepted as they stand.
* Reinforcement for the shelter and entry structures is taken verbatim from the SC1
  bar bending schedule: **70.46 t** across 92 bar marks. SC1's own convention is
  kept — cut length is the sum of scheduled legs with **no bend deduction**, laps
  at 50 φ added, stock bar 12 000. Bend deductions to BS 8666 Table 3 are the
  fabricator's on the approved schedule.
* The sentry post has never been quantified anywhere in the project. Its concrete
  (**20.95 m³ M30**) and reinforcement (**1.97 t**, about 94 kg/m³ — a plausible
  density for a small ductile-detailed frame) are derived here from the confirmed
  arrangement in master Part F.4, for **tender and estimating only**.
* Rates are not included. Rates come from the MES Standard Schedule of Rates. To be verified against the applicable MES SOR/SSR/specification edition.

## Section H notes — the sentry post brick masonry (SP-B1)

The walls between the sentry post columns are **one-brick-thick masonry in modular
bricks to IS 1077 (190 × 90 × 90)**, built inside the confirmed 200 mm structural
zone. The residual 10 mm is taken up at the internal face and absorbed in the
plaster, so the confirmed 4000 × 5000 external envelope and the flush column faces
are both preserved. Brickwork is measured at its **actual 190 mm thickness**, as
IS 1200 (Part 3) requires — not at the 200 mm zone width.

| | Ground storey | First storey | Total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Wall run between columns | 15.200 m | 15.200 m | — |
| Panel height | 2.600 m | 2.600 m | — |
| Gross face area | 39.52 m² | 39.52 m² | 79.04 m² |
| Openings deducted | 3.33 m² | 11.52 m² | 14.85 m² |
| **Net masonry face** | **36.19 m²** | **28.00 m²** | **64.19 m²** |
| **Volume at 190 thk** | **6.88 m³** | **5.32 m³** | **12.20 m³** |
| Bricks including 5 % breakage | — | — | **≈ 6 400 No.** |
| Cement for CM 1:6 | — | — | 14.5 bags |
| Sand | — | — | 3.0 m³ |

**Openings.** Ground storey: door D1 900 wide and window W1 1200 wide, both read
from Rev F drawing 3. First storey: eight armoured vision panels 1200 wide, two per
face on all four faces, plus door D1, read from Rev F drawing 4. Opening
**heights are not stated anywhere in the project**; 2100 for the door (the project
convention for every other door) and 1200 for the window and vision panels are
assumed for measurement and are flagged as verification items WM-V3.

**Lintels are a new requirement created by this change.** The RC infill panels did
not need them; brick masonry does. When this bill was measured no lintel design
existed, so item `SP-06` is a provisional 200 × 150 section for quantity only, classed
`[N]`.

> **Superseded by SP-B2, 10 September 2026 (master A.4.8, Part H.12).** Lintel **L1**
> is now designed — **190 × 150, M30 / Fe500, 2-T10 bottom, 2-T8 top, T6 links @ 150,
> bearing 200 each end**, one type over all eleven openings. Over the same 17.000 m run
> of lintel that is **0.485 m³** against `SP-06`'s **0.510 m³**. **`SP-06` is left as
> measured and is NOT re-measured here** — 26 litres of M30 changes nothing, and this
> bill is a preserved revision. The supersession is recorded in
> `Documentation/WM_RECONCILIATION_REGISTER.md` §6 so the next revision picks up L1,
> with its reinforcement, rather than a provisional section with none.

## Declared conservatisms

| Item | Effect |
|---|---|
| Mat measured gross, with no deduction for the 1.5 × 1.5 sump opening | +1.35 m³, SC1's convention, kept |
| Excavation faces taken vertical and unbenched, no batter volume added | Bulk excavation is a **lower bound** |
| Bulking on rock excavation not applied | Loose volumes for haulage will be 40–60 % greater |
| Reinforcement cut lengths with no bend deduction | Conservative by about 2 φ per 90° bend |
| Cement at 400 kg/m³ for M35 against the IS 456 Table 5 minimum of 340 | Trial mix to IS 10262 fixes the real content |
| Mortar fraction 23 % applied to a one-brick wall whose thickness carries no joint | Slightly over-measures mortar |

## Reconciliation with the project record

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Mat 600 = 22.000 × 6.200 × 0.600 | 81.84 against SC1's 81.8 — **agrees** |
| Pressure slab 900 net of the void and two shafts | 112.03 against SC1's 112.0 — **agrees** |
| Perimeter walls = (22.000 × 6.200 − 20.800 × 5.000) × 3.200 | 103.68 against SC1's 103.7 — **agrees** |
| Walls W6/W7 = 2 × 0.400 × 5.000 × 3.200 | 12.80 against SC1's 12.8 — **agrees** |
| Wall W5 = 0.200 × 5.000 × 3.200 | 3.20 against SC1's 3.2 — **agrees** |
| Headhouse walls + roof | 32.74 against SC1's 32.7 — **agrees** |
| Sentry post steel density, 1.97 t in 20.95 m³ | ≈ 94 kg/m³ — plausible for a ductile-detailed frame. A sanity check, not a design check |
| Engineered cover, six layers × their thicknesses | 2 000 mm total, reproducing master A.7.3 |
